paraphrase: Subscriptions must be truthful and transparent: the offer terms, cost, billing frequency, automatic renewal and whether a subscription is needed to use the app must be shown without extra effort; they must give sustained value, not a one-time benefit dressed as a subscription; annual prices may not be shown mainly as a monthly figure; 'free trial' names may not hide an automatic charge; purchase flows may not trick a subscribe tap, and there must be a visible way to continue without subscribing; terms must be fully localised.
